quotes_and_metrics_mapping.source_section: How Gemini 4 Argon Upleveled Teamwork / The Teamwork Sprint: Building FarArray in Hours
quotes_and_metrics_mapping.scope_note: Five-milestone FarArray pipeline: Transport Abstraction -> Core Pinned Arena -> Batched Doorbells -> Distributed Algorithms -> Live Audit

quotes_and_metrics_mapping.claim: Thread-local Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) early-exit pruning resolves 97%-99.9% of redundant graph edges in local worker RAM before touching the network; hardware telemetry tuning cut maximum read latency spikes by 89%
quotes_and_metrics_mapping.scope_note: FarArray supports Symmetric PGAS and Dedicated Worker/Server topologies over SmartNIC RDMA, Linux io_uring, and POSIX SHM; RDMA path uses PCIe MMIO doorbells and PCIe AtomicOps 64-bit CAS with zero remote CPU interrupts while TCP KV servers saturate at 100%

quotes_and_metrics_mapping.claim: Connected Components (ClueWeb12 & HyperLink 2012, up to 3.56B vertices, 113.6B-128.7B edges): 60x and 90x higher throughput, 40x (ClueWeb12) and 180x (HyperLink 2012) faster wall-clock time, 6x-22x less RAM vs TCP key-value baselines; >100x less DRAM vs distributed shuffle (28.5 GB vs 4.0 TB); 100% exact partition parity vs single-machine GBBS
quotes_and_metrics_mapping.scope_note: Distinct baselines (TCP KV vs distributed shuffle vs GBBS) reported per comparison

quotes_and_metrics_mapping.claim: Planet-Scale Connected Components (18.0B vertices, 1.14T unique / 2.27T symmetric edges): 148 GB total pinned DRAM across 64 targets (2.31 GB/node), 0 OOMs where >1 TiB TCP KV and >20 TB shuffle baselines are infeasible
quotes_and_metrics_mapping.scope_note: Feasibility result rather than direct speedup ratio against failing baselines

quotes_and_metrics_mapping.claim: Distributed InstantEmbedding (Personalized PageRank, 955M-3.56B vertices, up to 98.0B directed edges): peak concurrent RAM reduced 8.7-13.9x (caption: 8.69x ClueWeb12, 13.85x Hyperlink 2012), cumulative memory up to 55.9x (55.87x), per-hop latency 12.90x-30.26x, 8-hop iteration wall time 11.3-26.5x (11.29x-26.46x) vs MapReduce + Remote KV
quotes_and_metrics_mapping.source_section: Planet-Scale Results table & InstantEmbedding figure captions
quotes_and_metrics_mapping.scope_note: Exact caption precision included alongside rounded summary figures

quotes_and_metrics_mapping.claim: Pallas TPU v6e sparse SpMM kernel (50K nodes, 256D features, 214K to 20.97M edges; GIN SUM/MEAN and 1-/4-layer GCN): streams 4,096-edge COO blocks via SMEM, expands XLA scoped VMEM from 16 MiB to 122 MiB, uses (8, 128) 3D VREG tiling with 4-way unrolling and store-to-load register forwarding, and zero-float-residual custom_vjp; HLO temp HBM 111.5 MiB flat vs 20.2 GiB native JAX (up to 185.8x / 185.78x reduction at 20.97M edges); forward 10.5x-14.7x (10.45x-14.66x) and backward/forward+backward 8x-12x (7.96x-11.98x) with strict floating-point numerical parity
